'''The Beast of Vodal Kressh''' was a monstrous [[Sith alchemy/Legends|alchemical]] snarler that resided in the [[Tomb of Vodal Kressh]] on [[Athiss/Legends|Athiss]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. It was [[Mission to Athiss|slain]] by a strike team sent to investigate the [[Planet/Legends|planet]].
